title: Cebuano triathletes set to compete in Asia Triathlon Cup in Taiwan

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Three Cebuano triathletes will represent the Philippines in the 2026 Asia Triathlon Cup in New Taipei, Taiwan, this weekend. Leading the eight-member Philippine delegation is Raven Faith Alcoseba, the fastest Filipino finisher in the women’s individual triathlon at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Joining Alcoseba is fellow Southeast Asian Games (SEAG) gold medalist Matthew Justine Hermosa, who is set to make his return to international competition after missing the Philippine roster for the Asian Games.
